s-1.ptxt: Inspect Shift Lock Control Unit Assembly

s3.ptxt: Move the shift lever to P.
Check that the shift lever cannot be shifted to any position other than P when operated.
With the IG ON and the brake pedal depressed, check that the shift lever can be shifted out of the P position.

s2.ptxt: Inspect Shift Lock Release Button Operation

s3.ptxt: Move the shift lever to P.
Check that the shift lever can be shifted out of the P position when operated while pressing the shift lock release button.
